query:
Diagnose this workflow problem and explain the root cause and the correct fix direction:

LTX 2.3 image-audio-to-video: lips never move / no lip-sync to the provided audio for most users, video and audio otherwise generate fine.

desired.outcome: Several community workarounds, none official: remove/bypass the Prompt Enhancer group and explicitly write that the character 'lip-syncs their dialog' in the prompt (rocko107: 'I did get it to work'); raise SolidMask values 0.2→0.5 (ZELBIO); nag scale 3.2–4.2 plus negative prompt (othello77); other users report these don't work for them.
desired.quality: Diagnosis names the correct root cause (matching the recorded root cause) and proposes the fix direction; depth of reasoning matters more than exact wording.
desired.answer_guidance: Several community workarounds, none official: remove/bypass the Prompt Enhancer group and explicitly write that the character 'lip-syncs their dialog' in the prompt (rocko107: 'I did get it to work'); raise SolidMask values 0.2→0.5 (ZELBIO); nag scale 3.2–4.2 plus negative prompt (othello77); other users report these don't work for them.
desired.guidance_note: Known fix from the original issue thread. Use to verify the diagnosis targets the right root cause; alternative fixes that resolve the same root cause are acceptable.

_tags.hidden_requirement: Tune conditioning (bypass Prompt Enhancer, explicitly prompt lip-sync, raise SolidMask, adjust nag scale) so LTX 2.3 image-audio-to-video actually lip-syncs.
